```lua
local function trackFlight(player, st, origin, vel, power)
    local wall = walls[st.laneIndex]
    local blastLevel = player:GetAttribute("BlastLevel") or 0
    local char = player.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    local dir = cannon:GetAttribute("FlightDirection")
    local pos = hrp.Position
    local prevPos = pos
    local t = 0
    local dt = LaunchConfig.KEYFRAME_DT
    local events = {}
    local stuck = false
    local flightVel = vel
    while t < LaunchConfig.MAX_FLIGHT_TIME and state[player] == st do
        task.wait(dt)
        t += dt
        if not hrp.Parent then break end
        prevPos = pos
        pos = hrp.Position
        -- wall interaction (sub-step along the movement)
        if wall then
            local seg = pos - prevPos
            local segLen = seg.Magnitude
            if segLen > 0.01 then
                local SUB = math.max(1, math.ceil(segLen / (wall.blockSize / 2)))
                for s = 1, SUB do
                    local subPos = prevPos + seg * (s / SUB)
                    if wall:contains(subPos) then
                        local hardness = wall:hardnessAt(subPos)
                        if hardness > 0 then
                            local speed = flightVel.Magnitude
                            local radius = LaunchConfig.blastRadius(speed, hardness, blastLevel)
                            if radius < LaunchConfig.MIN_BLAST then
                                stuck = true
                                break
                            end
                            local info = wall:peekBlast(subPos, radius)
                            if info.count > 0 then
                                local newSpeed = speed * math.exp(-LaunchConfig.DRAIN_K * hardness * speed * dt / SUB)
                                if newSpeed < LaunchConfig.MIN_SPEED then
                                    stuck = true
                                    break
                                end
                                flightVel = flightVel.Unit * newSpeed
                                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = flightVel
                                wall:applyBlast(subPos, radius)
                                table.insert(events, {pos = subPos, radius = radius, hardness = hardness})
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if stuck then break end
        end
        -- landing
        if pos.Y <= LaunchConfig.LAND_HEIGHT and flightVel.Y < 0 then
            break
        end
    end
    -- result
    if state[player] ~= st then return end
    local distance = (pos - origin):Dot(dir)
    local best = player:GetAttribute("BestDistance") or 0
    local isBest = distance > best
    player:SetAttribute("LastDistance", math.floor(distance))
    if isBest then player:SetAttribute("BestDistance", math.floor(distance)) end
    remoteFinished:FireClient(player, distance, isBest)
    remoteVfx:FireClient(player, events)
end
```

```lua
local function trackFlight(player, st, origin, vel)
    local cannon = cannons[st.laneIndex]
    if not cannon then return end
    local dir = cannon:GetAttribute("FlightDirection")
    local wall = walls[st.laneIndex]
    local blastLevel = player:GetAttribute("BlastLevel") or 0
    local char = player.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    local pos = hrp.Position
    local prevPos = pos
    local flightVel = vel
    local t = 0
    local dt = LaunchConfig.KEYFRAME_DT
    local events = {}
    local stuck = false
    while t < LaunchConfig.MAX_FLIGHT_TIME and state[player] == st do
        task.wait(dt)
        t += dt
        if not hrp.Parent then break end
        prevPos = pos
        pos = hrp.Position
        -- wall interaction (sub-step along the movement)
        if wall then
            local seg = pos - prevPos
            local segLen = seg.Magnitude
            if segLen > 0.01 then
                local SUB = math.max(1, math.ceil(segLen / (wall.blockSize / 2)))
                for s = 1, SUB do
                    local subPos = prevPos + seg * (s / SUB)
                    if wall:contains(subPos) then
                        local hardness = wall:hardnessAt(subPos)
                        if hardness > 0 then
                            local speed = flightVel.Magnitude
                            local radius = LaunchConfig.blastRadius(speed, hardness, blastLevel)
                            if radius < LaunchConfig.MIN_BLAST then
                                stuck = true
                                break
                            end
                            local info = wall:peekBlast(subPos, radius)
                            if info.count > 0 then
                                local newSpeed = speed * math.exp(-LaunchConfig.DRAIN_K * hardness * speed * dt / SUB)
                                if newSpeed < LaunchConfig.MIN_SPEED then
                                    stuck = true
                                    break
                                end
                                flightVel = flightVel.Unit * newSpeed
                                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = flightVel
                                wall:applyBlast(subPos, radius)
                                table.insert(events, {pos = subPos, radius = radius, hardness = hardness})
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if stuck then break end
        end
        -- landing
        if pos.Y <= LaunchConfig.LAND_HEIGHT and flightVel.Y < 0 then
            break
        end
    end
    -- result
    if state[player] ~= st then return end
    local distance = (pos - origin):Dot(dir)
    local best = player:GetAttribute("BestDistance") or 0
    local isBest = distance > best
    player:SetAttribute("LastDistance", math.floor(distance))
    if isBest then player:SetAttribute("BestDistance", math.floor(distance)) end
    remoteFinished:FireClient(player, distance, isBest)
    if #events > 0 then remoteVfx:FireClient(player, events) end
end
```

```lua
-- track the player's ACTUAL flight: bore through the wall, drain speed, compute the result
local function trackFlight(player, st, origin, vel)
    local cannon = cannons[st.laneIndex]
    if not cannon then return end
    local dir = cannon:GetAttribute("FlightDirection")
    local wall = walls[st.laneIndex]
    local blastLevel = player:GetAttribute("BlastLevel") or 0
    local char = player.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    local pos = hrp.Position
    local prevPos = pos
    local flightVel = vel
    local t = 0
    local dt = LaunchConfig.KEYFRAME_DT
    local events = {}
    local stuck = false
    while t < LaunchConfig.MAX_FLIGHT_TIME and state[player] == st do
        task.wait(dt)
        t += dt
        if not hrp.Parent then break end
        prevPos = pos
        pos = hrp.Position
        if wall then
            local seg = pos - prevPos
            local segLen = seg.Magnitude
            if segLen > 0.01 then
                local SUB = math.max(1, math.ceil(segLen / (wall.blockSize / 2)))
                for s = 1, SUB do
                    local subPos = prevPos + seg * (s / SUB)
                    if wall:contains(subPos) then
                        local hardness = wall:hardnessAt(subPos)
                        if hardness > 0 then
                            local speed = flightVel.Magnitude
                            local radius = LaunchConfig.blastRadius(speed, hardness, blastLevel)
                            if radius < LaunchConfig.MIN_BLAST then
                                stuck = true
                                break
                            end
                            local info = wall:peekBlast(subPos, radius)
                            if info.count > 0 then
                                local newSpeed = speed * math.exp(-LaunchConfig.DRAIN_K * hardness * speed * dt / SUB)
                                if newSpeed < LaunchConfig.MIN_SPEED then
                                    stuck = true
                                    break
                                end
                                flightVel = flightVel.Unit * newSpeed
                                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = flightVel
                                wall:applyBlast(subPos, radius)
                                table.insert(events, {pos = subPos, radius = radius, hardness = hardness})
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if stuck then break end
        end
        if pos.Y <= LaunchConfig.LAND_HEIGHT and flightVel.Y < 0 then
            break
        end
    end
    if state[player] ~= st then return end
    local distance = (pos - origin):Dot(dir)
    local best = player:GetAttribute("BestDistance") or 0
    local isBest = distance > best
    player:SetAttribute("LastDistance", math.floor(distance))
    if isBest then player:SetAttribute("BestDistance", math.floor(distance)) end
    remoteFinished:FireClient(player, distance, isBest)
    if #events > 0 then remoteVfx:FireClient(player, events) end
end

remoteLeave.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
    local st = state[player]
    if st and st.phase == "Aiming" then sendHome(player) end
end)

local function refreshLane(i)
    local lane = lanesFolder:FindFirstChild("Lane" .. i)
    if not lane then return end
    local owner = lane:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") or 0
    local cannon = cannons[i]
    if owner == 0 then
        if cannon then cannon:Destroy() cannons[i] = nil end
        if walls[i] then walls[i].model:Destroy() walls[i] = nil end
        return
    end
    if cannon then
        cannon:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", owner)
    else
        cannon = CannonBuilder.build(lane, cannonsFolder)
        if not cannon then return end
        cannon:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", owner)
        cannons[i] = cannon
    end
    if walls[i] then
        walls[i]:reset()
    else
        walls[i] = WallBuilder.build(lane, lane)
    end
end

for i = 1, MAX_LANES do
```

```
-- track the player's ACTUAL flight: bore through the wall, drain speed, compute the result
local function trackFlight(player, st, origin, vel)
	local cannon = cannons[st.laneIndex]
	if not cannon then return end
	local dir = cannon:GetAttribute("FlightDirection")
	local wall = walls[st.laneIndex]
	local blastLevel = player:GetAttribute("BlastLevel") or 0
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end
	local pos = hrp.Position
	local prevPos = pos
	local flightVel = vel
	local t = 0
	local dt = LaunchConfig.KEYFRAME_DT
	local events = {}
	local stuck = false
	while t < LaunchConfig.MAX_FLIGHT_TIME and state[player] == st do
		task.wait(dt)
		t += dt
		if not hrp.Parent then break end
		prevPos = pos
		pos = hrp.Position
		-- wall interaction: sub-step along the real movement so the cone is smooth even at high speed
		if wall then
			local seg = pos - prevPos
			local segLen = seg.Magnitude
			if segLen > 0.01 then
				local SUB = math.max(1, math.ceil(segLen / (wall.blockSize / 2)))
				for s = 1, SUB do
					local subPos = prevPos + seg * (s / SUB)
					if wall:contains(subPos) then
						local hardness = wall:hardnessAt(subPos)
						if hardness > 0 then
							local speed = flightVel.Magnitude
							local radius = LaunchConfig.blastRadius(speed, hardness, blastLevel)
							if radius < LaunchConfig.MIN_BLAST then
								stuck = true
								break
							end
							local info = wall:peekBlast(subPos, radius)
							if info.count > 0 then
								local newSpeed = speed * math.exp(-LaunchConfig.DRAIN_K * hardness * speed * dt / SUB)
								if newSpeed < LaunchConfig.MIN_SPEED then
									stuck = true
									break
								end
								flightVel = flightVel.Unit * newSpeed
								hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = flightVel
								wall:applyBlast(subPos, radius)
								table.insert(events, {pos = subPos, radius = radius, hardness = hardness})
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			if stuck then break end
		end
		-- landing
		if pos.Y <= LaunchConfig.LAND_HEIGHT and flightVel.Y < 0 then
			break
		end
	end
	-- the result
	if state[player] ~= st then return end
	local distance = (pos - origin):Dot(dir)
	local best = player:GetAttribute("BestDistance") or 0
	local isBest = distance > best
	player:SetAttribute("LastDistance", math.floor(distance))
	if isBest then player:SetAttribute("BestDistance", math.floor(distance)) end
	remoteFinished:FireClient(player, distance, isBest)
	if #events > 0 then remoteVfx:FireClient(player, events) end
end

remotePress.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, pressTime)
	local st = state[player]
	if not st or st.phase ~= "Aiming" then return end
	local cannon = cannons[st.laneIndex]
	if not cannon then return end

	-- the client says WHEN it pressed (server clock); only a small lag is accepted
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if typeof(pressTime) ~= "number" or pressTime ~= pressTime then pressTime = now end
	pressTime = math.clamp(pressTime, math.max(st.barStart, now - LaunchConfig.MAX_PRESS_LAG), now)

	local origin = cannon:GetAttribute("SeatCFrame").Position
	local position = LaunchConfig.barPosition(pressTime - st.barStart)
	local power, rating = LaunchConfig.power(position)
```

-- track the player's ACTUAL flight: bore through the wall, drain speed, compute the result
local function trackFlight(player, st, origin, vel)
	local cannon = cannons[st.laneIndex]
	if not cannon then return end
	local dir = cannon:GetAttribute("FlightDirection")
	local wall = walls[st.laneIndex]
	local blastLevel = player:GetAttribute("BlastLevel") or 0
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end
	local pos = hrp.Position
	local prevPos = pos
	local flightVel = vel
	local t = 0
	local dt = LaunchConfig.KEYFRAME_DT
	local events = {}
	local stuck = false
	while t < LaunchConfig.MAX_FLIGHT_TIME and state[player] == st do
		task.wait(dt)
		t += dt
		if not hrp.Parent then break end
		prevPos = pos
		pos = hrp.Position
		-- wall interaction: sub-step along the real movement so the cone is smooth even at high speed
		if wall then
			local seg = pos - prevPos
			local segLen = seg.Magnitude
			if segLen > 0.01 then
				local SUB = math.max(1, math.ceil(segLen / (wall.blockSize / 2)))
				for s = 1, SUB do
					local subPos = prevPos + seg * (s / SUB)
					if wall:contains(subPos) then
						local hardness = wall:hardnessAt(subPos)
						if hardness > 0 then
							local speed = flightVel.Magnitude
							local radius = LaunchConfig.blastRadius(speed, hardness, blastLevel)
							if radius < LaunchConfig.MIN_BLAST then
								stuck = true
								break
							end
							local info = wall:peekBlast(subPos, radius)
							if info.count > 0 then
								local newSpeed = speed * math.exp(-LaunchConfig.DRAIN_K * hardness * speed * dt / SUB)
								if newSpeed < LaunchConfig.MIN_SPEED then
									stuck = true
									break
								end
								flightVel = flightVel.Unit * newSpeed
								hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = flightVel
								wall:applyBlast(subPos, radius)
								table.insert(events, {pos = subPos, radius = radius, hardness = hardness})
							end
						end
					end
			end
			if stuck then break end
		end
		-- landing
		if pos.Y <= LaunchConfig.LAND_HEIGHT and flightVel.Y < 0 then
			break
		end
	end
	-- the result
	if state[player] ~= st then return end
	local distance = (pos - origin):Dot(dir)
	local best = player:GetAttribute("BestDistance") or 0
	local isBest = distance > best
	player:SetAttribute("LastDistance", math.floor(distance))
	if isBest then player:SetAttribute("BestDistance", math.floor(distance)) end
	remoteFinished:FireClient(player, distance, isBest)
	if #events > 0 then remoteVfx:FireClient(player, events) end
end

remotePress.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, pressTime)
	local st = state[player]
	if not st or st.phase ~= "Aiming" then return end
	local cannon = cannons[st.laneIndex]
	if not cannon then return end

	-- the client says WHEN it pressed (server clock); only a small lag is accepted
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if typeof(pressTime) ~= "number" or pressTime ~= pressTime then pressTime = now end
	pressTime = math.clamp(pressTime, math.max(st.barStart, now - LaunchConfig.MAX_PRESS_LAG), now)

	local origin = cannon:GetAttribute("SeatCFrame").Position
	local position = LaunchConfig.barPosition(pressTime - st.barStart)
	local power, rating = LaunchConfig.power(position)

	st.phase = "Launching"
	player:SetAttribute("CannonState", "Launching")
	local startTime = now + LaunchConfig.START_DELAY

	remoteStarted:FireClient(player, rating, power)

	-- fire the cannon recoil + smoke when the flight starts
	task.delay(LaunchConfig.START_DELAY, function()
		if state[player] == st and cannons[st.laneIndex] == cannon then CannonBuilder.fire(cannon) end
	end)

	-- launch the player with a real velocity, then track the actual flight
	task.delay(LaunchConfig.START_DELAY, function()
		if state[player] ~= st then return end
		local char = player.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then return end
		local speed = LaunchConfig.MAX_SPEED * power
		local pitch = math.rad(LaunchConfig.PITCH_DEG)
		local vel = cannon:GetAttribute("FlightDirection") * (speed * math.cos(pitch)) + Vector3.yAxis * (speed * math.sin(pitch))
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vel
		task.spawn(function() trackFlight(player, st, origin, vel) end)
	end)

	-- send the player home
	task.delay(LaunchConfig.START_DELAY + LaunchConfig.MAX_FLIGHT_TIME + LaunchConfig.RESULT_TIME, function()
		if state[player] == st then sendHome(player) end
	end)
end)

```lua
RunService:BindToRenderStep("LaunchController", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(dt)
	if state == "Idle" then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end
```
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

	if state == "Aiming" then
		pointer.Position = UDim2.fromScale(LaunchConfig.barPosition(now - barStart), 0.5)
	end
	if state == "Launching" and flight and now >= flight.startTime then
		state = "Flying"
		TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {FieldOfView = 95}):Play()   -- FOV kick
	end

	if state == "Aiming" or state == "Launching" then
		hrp.CFrame = seatCFrame
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		camera.CFrame = aimCamera
	else
		-- flying: play the recorded keyframes (Hermite) + blast VFX
		local elapsed = now - flight.startTime
		local kfs = flight.keyframes
		local i = flight.index
		while i < #kfs and kfs[i + 1].t < elapsed do i += 1 end
		flight.index = i
		local t0, p0, v0 = kfs[i].t, kfs[i].pos, kfs[i].vel
		local k1 = kfs[i + 1]
		local t1, p1, v1 = k1.t, k1.pos, k1.vel
		local h = math.max(t1 - t0, 1e-4)
		local s = math.clamp((elapsed - t0) / h, 0, 1)
		local s2, s3 = s * s, s * s * s
		local pos = (2*s3 - 3*s2 + 1)*p0 + (s3 - 2*s2 + s)*h*v0 + (-2*s3 + 3*s2)*p1 + (s3 - s2)*h*v1
		local vel = (p1 - p0) / h
		local landed = elapsed >= flight.duration

		-- head first, nose follows the flight path (flat once landed)
		local look = lastLook
		if vel.Magnitude > 0.1 then
			look = vel.Unit
			lastLook = look
		end
		hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + look) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

		if landed then
			if state == "Flying" then
				state = "Landed"
				TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {FieldOfView = 70}):Play()
			end
			hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		else
			hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vel
		end

		-- camera behind the flight + blast VFX
		local flat = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z)
		local camLook = flat.Magnitude > 0.1 and flat.Unit or lastLook
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos - camLook * 34 + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0), pos + camLook * 40) + Vfx.update(dt)

		local ei = flight.eventIndex
		while ei <= #flight.events and flight.events[ei].t <= elapsed do
			local ev = flight.events[ei]
			Vfx.blast(ev.pos, ev.radius, ev.hardness)
			ei += 1
		end
		flight.eventIndex = ei
	end
end)

RunService:BindToRenderStep("LaunchController", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(dt)
	if state == "Idle" then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end
	Vfx.update(dt)   -- decay the camera shake from the blasts

	if state == "Aiming" then
		pointer.Position = UDim2.fromScale(LaunchConfig.barPosition(workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - barStart), 0.5)
		hrp.CFrame = seatCFrame
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		camera.CFrame = aimCamera
	elseif state == "Launching" then
		-- the server owns the character (real physics); the camera follows the flight
		local flat = Vector3.new(hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
		local camLook = flat.Magnitude > 0.1 and flat.Unit or hrp.CFrame.LookVector
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position - camLook * 34 + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0), hrp.Position + camLook * 40)
	end
end)
